The '''Dervdisi fashioned suit''' was a type of [[Suit/Legends|suit]]<ref name="Galladinium" /> that originated in<ref name="Planetnamia" /> the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds']] [[Dervdis system/Legends|Dervdis system]].<ref name="EAOC" /> At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'' is set during the [[Time/Legends|time]] period between the events of {{Film|IV}} and {{Film|V}}, which corresponds to some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> [[Justahl]], the [[Vice President/Legends|vice president]] of a company, owned the latest Dervdisi fashioned [[Clothing/Legends|suit]]. He wore the suit to attend a meeting concerning his share options, which he arrived at with the help of a small, back-mounted [[Arakyd Aerodynes, Inc.]] [[Hush-About AJP-400]] [[Jetpack/Legends|jetpack]].<ref name="Galladinium" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Dervdisi fashioned suit was mentioned in ''[[Galladinium's Fantastic Technology]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook authored by [[Rick D. Stuart]] for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Galladinium" />
